name: Sibbechai
overview: Sibbechai, also known as Sibbecai, was a distinguished captain in King David's army, noted for his valor in battle against the Philistines. Scripture records him as a Hushathite warrior who notably slew giants among the enemy, such as Saph and Sippai, demonstrating God's empowerment of David's forces over formidable foes. He also held a leadership role commanding 24,000 men during his appointed month, underscoring his significant military responsibility and trust within David's ranks.
